UX-angle comment posted on #91: https://github.com/mvox-dev/mvox_v4e_web/issues/91#issuecomment-4701405570

Covered: UX difference (one-button instant vs request→approve deferred), what survives a pivot (createInvitation/buildInviteUrl/listOrgInvitations/resolveInvite/all UI components intact; createApplication + the BFF accept endpoint at risk), and the option-3 client complexity (owner enumeration + _viewer grants before "request sent" state).

Session 35 closing. Scratchpad updated at teams/mvox-dev/memory/byrd.md.

[LEARNED] Biome format is a mandatory gate step — `pnpm format` before commit, not just `pnpm lint:fix`. Both were separate Bentham findings this round.
[LEARNED] `pnpm build` required after adding new Paraglide keys (not just `pnpm check`) — Paraglide recompilation only triggers on build.
[LEARNED] MvoxNav is layout-only; never add to individual pages or the spec mock gap manifests immediately.
[LEARNED] `vi.waitFor` required for any page spec asserting post-`$effect` state.
[LEARNED] Paraglide page spec mock must cover all sub-component keys that render when `loadState==='ready'`.
[LEARNED] `InviteProjection.orgId` non-optional — Josquin's projection always returns it.
[LEARNED] `createInvitation` phantom `status` prop — invitation type has no status (Pérotin probe).

[DEFERRED] Slice-3 accept architecture — #91. Branch feat/invite-join (8b5ec86) conserved, 1127/1127 GREEN, not merged. Schema-design pass needed.
